name: aapl_vol_ratio_5_20
hypothesis: Raw volatility level depends on the regime and differs across years; the short/long ratio captures vol expansion or contraction, which is scale-free and more stable across years.
lesson: Ratio of short to long vol is nearly a rescaled copy of AAPL_volatility_5d and its level information is lost, so it was noise in 2022 and 2024.

name: msft_return_zscore_20d
hypothesis: MSFT's raw 1d return is scaled differently in high- and low-vol years; standardizing it makes the signal comparable across regimes.
lesson: Standardizing MSFT's return mostly duplicates MSFT_return_1d, helping RF slightly but being unstable in 2024 when MSFT vol was low.

name: aapl_close_position_in_range
hypothesis: Where the close sits in the day's range shows end-of-day buying or selling pressure, which may continue or revert next day.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.001 (2/4 years)
lesson: Intraday close location carries a weak mean-reversion/momentum signal that flips sign across regimes, so it helped only in 2023 and 2025.

name: qqq_vol_ratio_5_20
hypothesis: Rising short-term tech-market volatility relative to its norm signals stress, after which rebounds in AAPL are more likely.
lesson: Market vol-change ratio is new information but has no stable link to Apple's next-day direction.

name: aapl_overnight_gap
hypothesis: Apple's overnight gap relative to QQQ's gap complements the volatility state by showing idiosyncratic sentiment, which tends to revert intraday and next day.
lesson: Overnight gap relative to QQQ helped LR in 2023 but the sign of its effect (fade vs follow) changed in 2024, hurting badly.

name: peer_dispersion_5d
hypothesis: When NVDA and MSFT disagree over 5 days, tech leadership is unstable; this conditions how the NVDA 5d momentum feeds into AAPL.
lesson: Absolute dispersion is unsigned and dominated by NVDA spikes, so it gave no direction and hurt in 2024.

name: aapl_gap_sign_vs_prev_close
hypothesis: The raw gap had outliers that made LR unstable in 2024; taking only the sign keeps the direction while removing the size outliers.
reason: constant or missing in a training/validation quarter
lesson: Sign of the relative gap was constant/missing in some quarter because the formula degenerated, so it was unusable and sign-only transformations of gaps are fragile.

name: aapl_close_position_zscore_5d
hypothesis: Single-day close location is noisy; comparing it to its own 5-day average isolates unusual closes and should reduce regime flipping.
lesson: Z-scoring a bounded intraday position over 5 days mostly added noise and removed the level information that gave the small LR gain.

name: aapl_close_vs_20d_high
hypothesis: Drawdown from the 20-day high captures pullback and mean-reversion state, differing from the MA distance already present.
lesson: It is nearly the same as distance to the 20d mean, so it carried no new information and shared its regime-flipping behavior.

name: qqq_close_to_ma20
hypothesis: Market trend state gives context for whether Apple's drift persists; Apple-only trend measures already exist but the market's does not.
lesson: QQQ trend vs MA is largely redundant with QQQ 5d return and its mean-reversion/momentum sign flips between 2022 bear and other years.

name: aapl_minus_qqq_cum_5d
hypothesis: Multi-day relative strength combined with intraday close location could separate real Apple weakness from market-driven moves, mean reverting when Apple has lagged.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.002 (2/4 years)
lesson: Relative 5d performance overlaps with Apple's own 5d momentum and its sign flips across regimes, helping only in 2023 and 2025.

name: msft_volume_surge
hypothesis: Peer volume surges flag information days; together with Apple's close location it may indicate whether the day's close is conviction or noise.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.005 (2/4 years)
lesson: Unusual MSFT volume is a market-attention proxy that carried slightly new information helping both models, but its effect was unstable in 2022 and 2024.

name: msft_volume_surge_signed
hypothesis: Volume surge without direction was unstable (2022, 2024); signing it by MSFT's return separates high-volume selling from buying, which should transfer to Apple's next move.
lesson: Multiplying by the return sign destroyed the attention information in the volume surge and mixed it with the return already in MSFT_return_1d, so it only helped in 2025.

name: aapl_minus_qqq_5d_volscaled
hypothesis: The raw relative move failed in 2024 when vol was low and 2022 when high; scaling by Apple's 20d vol makes it comparable across regimes.
lesson: Dividing by Apple's own 20d vol made it a noisy rescaled copy of 5d momentum with a regime-dependent sign, hurting in 2022 and 2024.

name: nvda_volume_surge
hypothesis: Tech-sector risk appetite shows in NVDA turnover; abnormal NVDA volume may signal sector stress that precedes Apple moves.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.008 (2/4 years)
lesson: Unusual NVDA volume is a new attention proxy that gave big gains in 2023 but lost in 2022 and 2024, so it is unstable and probably regime dependent.

name: qqq_range_vs_aapl_range
formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(QQQ_High, QQQ_Low), QQQ_Close), safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), AAPL_Close))
hypothesis: When Apple's intraday range is wide relative to the market's, Apple-specific noise is high and tends to mean-revert next day.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.004 (3/4 years)
lesson: Relative range captured Apple-specific turbulence versus the market and helped three years, but 2022's market-wide high-vol regime made it a drag.

name: aapl_volume_surge_signed
hypothesis: Pairs MSFT volume attention with Apple's own volume-confirmed direction; high-volume up/down days carry continuation or exhaustion information different from the peer volume signal.
lesson: Apple's own signed volume surge duplicates the information in the daily return and gave gains only in the calmer 2023 and 2025 regimes.

name: aapl_close_position_vs_qqq_position
formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_Close, AAPL_Low), subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low)), safe_divide(subtract(QQQ_Close, QQQ_Low), subtract(QQQ_High, QQQ_Low)))
hypothesis: Apple's close location relative to the market's close location removes the market-wide component of the intraday signal, complementing the raw Apple position that flipped sign by regime.
lesson: The difference of two bounded intraday positions is noisy and flipped sign between 2022-23 and 2024-25, so it was no better than the single position.

name: peer_volume_surge_mean
hypothesis: NVDA and MSFT volume surges each flip in different years; averaging them cuts idiosyncratic noise and uses the pair's +0.014 in a single, less noisy factor.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.004 (2/4 years)
lesson: Averaging NVDA and MSFT volume z-scores kept the 2023/2025 gains and 2022/2024 losses, so combining them added no stability.

name: nvda_volume_surge_60d
hypothesis: A 20d baseline adapts too quickly to the NVDA volume regime, which probably caused the 2022 and 2024 failures; a 60d baseline gives a steadier measure of unusual attention.
lesson: A 60d baseline made the surge a slow level measure that lost the short-term attention signal and only helped in 2023.

name: aapl_vs_peer_vol_ratio
hypothesis: Apple's idiosyncratic volatility relative to the market signals stress specific to Apple, which may predict mean reversion in a way that is stable across regimes.
lesson: Ratio of Apple to QQQ volatility is a noisy rescaling of Apple vol that hurt in 2022 and 2024 and helped neither model.

name: qqq_return_zscore_10d
hypothesis: A QQQ move scaled by its recent volatility separates real shocks from normal noise across regimes, unlike the raw 1d return, which depends on vol level.
lesson: Z-scoring QQQ's return was a near-copy of QQQ_return_1d and added only noise.

name: aapl_volume_vs_peer_volume
hypothesis: When NVDA's volume surges without Apple's, the attention is elsewhere; this contrasts Apple's volume with NVDA's and complements the market-attention reading.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.012 (2/4 years)
lesson: Apple's volume surge relative to NVDA's helped both models in 2023 and 2025 but failed in 2022 and 2024, making it the best but still regime-dependent volume signal.

name: aapl_minus_msft_cum_3d
hypothesis: Apple's short-term performance relative to MSFT, the most similar mega-cap, gives a direction to pair with MSFT's unusual volume without overlapping 5d momentum.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.002 (2/4 years)
lesson: Three-day relative performance vs MSFT overlaps Apple's own short momentum and its sign flips across regimes, so gain was negligible.

name: aapl_volume_vs_peer_volume_5d_smooth
hypothesis: The daily version is noisy and failed in 2022/2024; smoothing volume over 3 days should reduce single-day spikes and give a steadier attention-gap signal.
lesson: Smoothing volume over 3 days removed the one-day attention spike that carried the signal, so the gain vanished.

name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_surge
hypothesis: NVDA volume is idiosyncratic and drove the 2022/2024 failures; QQQ volume is a broader market-activity baseline so the Apple-specific volume excess should be more stable.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.010 (2/4 years)
lesson: Apple volume surge relative to QQQ helped both models in 2023 and 2025 but failed in 2022 and 2024, similar to the NVDA version so it is regime dependent.

name: qqq_volume_change_signed_by_trend
hypothesis: Short-vs-long market volume activity captures regime shifts in participation (capitulation or calm) not covered by any factor so far.
lesson: Short-vs-long QQQ volume zscore difference was a slow market-level measure with no predictive information for Apple in any year.

name: aapl_high_vs_prev_close_gap
hypothesis: Compares upside vs downside excursion from yesterday's close using high and low, a skew in intraday extremes that return and range factors miss.
lesson: Upside-minus-downside excursion from prior close is almost the same as the daily return (0.89 similarity) and added noise, hurting 2024.

name: aapl_volume_surge_vol_state
hypothesis: The volume signal changes meaning between high-vol (2022) and low-vol regimes; a market vol-state variable lets models condition on it, complementing the volume gap.
lesson: QQQ short/long volatility ratio is a rescaled vol factor that only helped in 2025 and was noise elsewhere.

name: aapl_minus_qqq_with_volume_confirm
hypothesis: Apple's relative move matters differently when attention (NVDA volume) is high; the interaction gives the model the conditional relation that additive terms cannot.
lesson: Multiplying relative return by NVDA volume z-score created a noisy interaction dominated by volume outliers that hurt in 2025.

name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_surge_5d
hypothesis: The 20d baseline made the signal flip in 2022 and 2024; a 5d average against a 60d baseline captures persistent attention differences and should be steadier across regimes.
lesson: Smoothing volume over 5 days against a 60d baseline made a slow level measure that lost the one-day attention spike and hurt in 3 of 4 years.

name: aapl_volume_vs_msft_nvda_volume
hypothesis: Comparing Apple's volume surge with the average of both peers reduces idiosyncratic NVDA noise that hurt 2024 while keeping the 2023/2025 gain.
lesson: Averaging MSFT and NVDA volume z-scores as the benchmark diluted the NVDA-specific contrast and only helped LR, so the signal vanished.

name: aapl_volume_price_range_pressure
hypothesis: High volume combined with wide range signals capitulation or climactic moves that tend to revert next day, a nonlinear interaction the existing factors lack.
lesson: Multiplying volume z-score by daily range nearly duplicated volume_to_ma20 and gave strongly negative results in 2024.

name: msft_nvda_minus_qqq_5d
hypothesis: Whether big tech leaders outperform the index shows breadth/leadership in the tech sector, which may influence Apple's next day follow-through.
lesson: Peer 5d outperformance versus QQQ is largely a rescaled NVDA 5d return and its sign flips across regimes, so it hurt.

name: qqq_return_vs_aapl_vol_state
hypothesis: A volatility-normalized QQQ move describes the market state; combined with Apple's relative volume it should tell whether the attention surge is market driven or Apple specific.
lesson: Dividing QQQ return by its own volatility is a near-copy of QQQ_return_1d and added nothing.

name: aapl_minus_qqq_gap_3d_mean
hypothesis: Persistent 10-day Apple relative strength vs QQQ combined with a relative volume surge indicates whether Apple attention is accompanied by sustained leadership or lag.
lesson: A 10d mean of Apple minus QQQ daily returns overlaps with Apple's own 10d mean return and its sign flips across regimes.

name: aapl_vs_nvda_volume_change_1d
hypothesis: The z-score versions depend on the 20d baseline whose scale differs between regimes (2022, 2024); a day-over-day log volume change difference removes the baseline and captures the pure attention shift Apple vs NVDA.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.004 (3/4 years)
lesson: One-day log volume change differences helped LR in 3 years but were tiny and RF ignored them, so the signal is weak and mostly linear.

name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_surge_60d_base
hypothesis: Failures in 2022 and 2024 probably come from both z-scores moving together with market-wide volume; using a slow QQQ baseline retains market-wide volume level info so the difference isolates Apple-specific surge versus the market state.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.015 (2/4 years)
lesson: A slower QQQ volume baseline improved the AAPL-vs-QQQ volume contrast slightly and helped both models, but still failed in 2022 and 2024.

name: aapl_down_volume_pressure
hypothesis: Volume-weighted 5d return flow measures accumulation or distribution by Apple holders, which may predict continuation or reversal beyond plain returns.
lesson: Volume-weighted 5d return sum was essentially a copy of AAPL_mean_return_5d, so it added nothing and inherited its regime flipping.

name: aapl_range_expansion_vs_5d
hypothesis: Today's range relative to the recent average range signals volatility expansion or exhaustion, a different view than close-normalised daily range.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.007 (2/4 years)
lesson: Range relative to its recent average mostly repeats the daily range and only helped RF in calm 2023 and 2025.

name: qqq_trend_regime_20_60
hypothesis: The volume signal flips between bear 2022 and bull years; a QQQ medium-term trend regime variable lets the model condition on that sign flip.
lesson: A slow QQQ trend gauge is a level-type feature that drifted across years, badly hurting 2024 and giving no stable signal.

name: aapl_minus_nvda_1d_return
hypothesis: Apple's volume surge against the market combined with its same-day return gap versus NVDA, the highest-attention peer, may show whether the volume is rotation flow in or out of Apple.
lesson: Apple minus NVDA daily return is nearly the same as the existing peer-mean relative factor, so it was redundant and unstable.

name: aapl_vs_qqq_volume_60d_both
hypothesis: The 20d-vs-60d mix fails in 2022 and 2024 probably because regimes shift the volume level; using the same 60d window on both sides gives a cleaner relative attention contrast that is less dependent on short bursts.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.011 (2/4 years)

name: aapl_vs_nvda_volume_surge_vol_scaled
hypothesis: The volume contrast failed in high-vol 2022 and low-vol 2024 because its effect scales with volatility; dividing by Apple's 20d volatility normalises it across regimes.
reason: not enough for the team yet but some sign of life: alone +0.010 (2/4 years)

name: aapl_close_vs_prior_5d_low_range
hypothesis: Stochastic-style position within the 10d high-low channel captures overbought or oversold state, which differs from the one-day close position and from MA distance.

name: qqq_down_day_count_10d
hypothesis: The fraction of up versus down QQQ days over 10 sessions measures market breadth in direction, not magnitude, and may separate trending from choppy regimes.

name: aapl_lag_return_2d_vs_msft
hypothesis: Yesterday's MSFT lead over Apple provides a catch-up signal, which complements a volume attention signal by describing the delayed peer move.

name: qqq_volume_trend_vs_aapl_range
hypothesis: Market-wide volume jumps without a matching range expansion indicate quiet accumulation or absorption; this market state complements Apple's volume relative to NVDA.
